verdict.rationale: Cross-device session handoff is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a local experimental browser UI working on a local git repo and automatic git commits. Pushing and pulling the repo between machines would be a user-side git workaround, not a product feature, and nothing documents syncing or resuming a task session from another device or browser.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
